the pairs, fork block and whale of gas-1114.tsv; buckets k2, k4, k6, whale (a bucket whose floor >= W is out)
sha256(utf8('gas-1114-aged|' + chain + '|' + token_a + '|' + token_b + '|' + bucket + '|' + str(i))); size and amount as in gas-1114.tsv (k: 10^(k+f); whale: W * 2^(-f)) at the fork-block prices

sha256(utf8('gas-1114-aged-block|' + chain + '|' + token_a + '|' + token_b + '|' + bucket + '|' + str(i))); back_s = 60 + f * (86400 - 60); block_quote N = the first block with timestamp >= ts(fork_block) - back_s, from the real block timestamps

7, 10, 25 s; block_exec = the first block with timestamp >= ts(N) + age, from the real block timestamps; k_blocks = block_exec - N and age_s_real = ts(block_exec) - ts(N) are recorded; the block time is measured, never assumed (Arbitrum and Robinhood: block.number inside the contract is the L1 number; the age uses the L2 block timestamps)
one quote block N and one amount per draw, shared by the 3 ages: the ages are paired

fork at N: Quoter -> pv.route (plan) and out_orig; fork at block_exec: swapExactIn(pv.route) -> status, err, out_exec, gas_real; same fork: a fresh quote -> out_fresh_exec. Forks in series (anvil_reset or a new anvil), never two alive, real state only

per chain x pair x bucket x age: % reverts with the error (RouterE(n), minOut, slippage, other), Wilson 95 % interval; on the ones that pass, d_bps_vs_fresh = 10000 * (out_exec - out_fresh_exec) / out_fresh_exec and d_bps_vs_orig = 10000 * (out_exec - out_orig) / out_orig, median with the bootstrap 95 % interval (B = 10000, seed sha256(utf8('gas-1114-aged-boot|' + stratum_id))), and n
prefix i < N', N' in {8, 4, 2, 1}, the same everywhere, by budget only, before any result is read; runs go i-major
